hvac.name: Summit Air Heating & Cooling
hvac.description: Family-owned HVAC company: AC and furnace repair, maintenance plans, and new system installs for homes.
hvac.hours: Mon–Fri 7am–6pm, Sat 8am–2pm. Emergency no-heat / no-cool calls answered 24/7.
hvac.service_area: San Fernando Valley and Santa Clarita Valley (Van Nuys, Burbank, North Hollywood, Northridge, Valencia, Santa Clarita)
facts: Service calls are $89 for the diagnostic visit, waived if the customer goes ahead with the repair. Exact repair prices are quoted on site after diagnosis; never quoted over the phone.

After-hours emergency visits carry a $150 after-hours fee. A gas smell or a carbon monoxide alarm is never booked as a service call: the caller must leave the home and call SoCalGas at 1-800-427-2200 or 911 first.
Comfort Club maintenance plan: $189/year, two tune-ups (spring AC, fall furnace), 15% off repairs, priority scheduling.
Services all major brands; installs Carrier and Lennox. Free in-home estimates for new systems. Financing available with approved credit.

plumbing.name: Blue Line Plumbing
plumbing.description: Residential plumbing: leaks, clogs, water heaters, repiping, and sewer line inspections.
plumbing.hours: Mon–Fri 7am–5pm. Emergency leak and sewage calls answered 24/7.
plumbing.service_area: San Fernando Valley and Santa Clarita Valley (Van Nuys, Burbank, North Hollywood, Northridge, Valencia, Santa Clarita)
facts: Service calls are $79, applied to the repair if the customer proceeds. Repair prices are quoted on site; no prices are promised over the phone.

For an active leak or burst pipe: first tell the caller to shut off the main water valve (where the water line enters the house, or at the street meter) and turn off power to any wet outlets, then dispatch the on-call plumber.
Repairs and replaces tank and tankless water heaters; same-day replacement often available for standard 40/50 gallon tanks.
Sewer camera inspection is $249 and includes a recording of the line.

electrical.name: Brightwire Electric
electrical.description: Licensed residential electricians: panel upgrades, EV chargers, troubleshooting, lighting, and code corrections.
electrical.hours: Mon–Fri 8am–5pm. Emergency calls (sparking, burning smell, total power loss) answered 24/7.
electrical.service_area: San Fernando Valley and Santa Clarita Valley (Van Nuys, Burbank, North Hollywood, Northridge, Valencia, Santa Clarita)
facts: Troubleshooting visits are $119 for the first hour. Larger jobs (panel upgrades, EV chargers) get a free written estimate after a site visit. No firm prices over the phone.
Sparking, smoke, or a burning smell from a panel, outlet, or wiring: the caller must not touch it, should leave the area if it's safe to, and call 911. Then offer an emergency visit.
Installs Level 2 EV chargers (Tesla Wall Connector, ChargePoint, JuiceBox); most homes need a load calculation first, some need a panel upgrade.
Pulls city permits for panel upgrades and new circuits; permit fees passed through at cost.

roofing.name: Ridgeline Roofing
roofing.description: Roof repair, leak response, and full replacements (shingle, tile, and flat roofs) for homes.
roofing.hours: Mon–Sat 7am–5pm. Active-leak calls during storms answered 24/7.
roofing.service_area: San Fernando Valley and Santa Clarita Valley (Van Nuys, Burbank, North Hollywood, Northridge, Valencia, Santa Clarita)
facts: Roof inspections and replacement estimates are free. Repair and replacement prices are given in a written estimate after inspection, never over the phone.
For an active leak: move valuables away, put a bucket under the drip, and stay off the roof, especially in rain. Emergency tarping is typically $300–$600, scheduled as soon as it's safe.
Documents storm damage with photos for insurance claims and can meet the adjuster on site. Never promises insurance will cover anything.
Workmanship warranty: 10 years on replacements, 2 years on repairs.
